Root_Cause: Object reference is null due to uninitialized variable or missing null check
Action: Add null validation before accessing object properties
EVENT_INFORMATION: {"Exception": {"Exception Type": "System.NullReferenceException", "Message": "Object reference not set to an instance of an object"}}

Root_Cause: Database constraint violation - duplicate key detected
Action: Implement upsert logic or check for existing record before insert

Root_Cause: Operation exceeded timeout threshold - typically network or database latency
Action: Increase timeout value or optimize slow query. Check network connectivity.

Root_Cause: Empty sequence accessed with First() or Single() - missing data validation
Action: Use FirstOrDefault() with null check or validate collection before access

Root_Cause: Oracle unique constraint violation - duplicate primary key
Action: Verify data uniqueness before insert or use MERGE statement

Root_Cause: External service unavailable or network connectivity issue
Action: Retry with exponential backoff. Check service health and network.

Root_Cause: Invalid input parameter - caller provided null or empty value
Action: This is a caller error. Fix calling code to validate parameters.
EVENT_INFORMATION: {"Exception": {"Exception Type": "System.ArgumentException", "Message": "Value cannot be null or empty"}}

Root_Cause: Invalid data format - string could not be parsed
Action: Validate input format before parsing. Add data cleansing step.
EVENT_INFORMATION: {"Exception": {"Exception Type": "System.FormatException", "Message": "Input string was not in a correct format"}}

Root_Cause: File does not exist at expected path - check file availability
Action: Verify file exists before access. Implement retry or alternative source.

Root_Cause: Application exceeded available memory - memory leak or large data set
Action: Reduce batch size, implement pagination, or increase memory allocation
